description: A Next.js client component builds a Supabase client with the anon key and calls supabase.auth.admin.listUsers() / deleteUser() from the browser. The admin API needs elevated privileges the anon key does not have — the usual next step is pasting the service_role key into the client to make it work. VC013 must fire on the auth.admin calls. The findings used to land on the NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY line (line 9) instead of the listUsers() call, because the match could start at any earlier 'supabase' across lines.
